limitations: Only the 47 Table S1 supplement rows (hospital Days 1-4, patient p1) are series; main-article tables hold single ED-presentation values or one-time imaging measurements and are not serial series, so their cells are omitted.
Time is the printed hospital-day label only; no numeric offsets, clock times or calendar dates are asserted. The physically blank aPTT Day 3 cell has no printed text and is absent.
Differential-count reference ranges (and the CRP reference < 0.5 against the mg/L unit) are printed on a different scale from their units and are not converted.
